payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the effectiveness of the NCEL approach, demonstrating its superior performance compared to baseline methods across various datasets and its ability to generalize well.

claims.text: NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with a favorable generalization ability across five public benchmarks.
NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% Macro F1 compared to other global models.
In both easy and hard datasets, NCEL outperforms all baseline methods, demonstrating its robustness in different scenarios.
NCEL is efficient for large-scale data due to its unique application of GCN on subgraphs and batch techniques.
